description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amended Extraordinary Gazette No.2235/22 On 6th July 2021, Issued Under the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12.of 2017
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically amending existing regulations regarding capital transactions by non-residents. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
